description:
Configure Wireshark to perform a live capture on the primary network interface (eth0) that records ONLY ICMP traffic (pings), while completely ignoring the background HTTP/TCP noise. 

1. Open Wireshark and identify the 'eth0' interface.
2. Enter a **Capture Filter** (not a Display Filter) to restrict recording to ICMP packets only.
3. Start the capture.
4. Open a terminal and run 'ping -c 10 8.8.8.8' to generate traffic.
5. Stop the capture after the pings finish.
6. Save the capture to '/home/ga/Documents/captures/icmp_strict.pcapng'.

The resulting file must contain at least 10 ICMP packets and EXACTLY ZERO non-ICMP packets.
